description: Rename one of your skills. Only the name line in the frontmatter of SKILL.md changes, as a new version; its command is a separate setting and stays. The skill is switched off and gets status needs-review, so it does not run under its new name until the user checks it. The skill is saved disabled. The user must review and enable it in Besidka at the reviewUrl in the result. At most 30 skill changes an hour. Requires signing in (skills:write).

name.description: The new name: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, 1 to 64 characters, not used by another of your skills and not a name Besidka reserves

name: rename_skill
title: Rename a skill
